status: Locally locked before fitting or evaluating the two confirmation benchmarks; not externally preregistered
method: Sparse randomized person/window/annotation-block acquisition under three paired historical loss guards
selection_reason: On the four LR development pilots, kappa=0.5 mixtures exceeded the one-point average shortfall margin in three datasets; kappa=1 retained approximately 49-55% savings with all three mean changes within one point. Meta correction worsened held-dataset prediction MSE and is not adopted.
cost_formula: m*(n+c+d*(b-1)); modeled effort, not measured money
block_schedule: Divide each person's retained chronological windows into b equal-index strata and take contiguous balanced quotas totaling n, with a random admissible start in each stratum; no calibration labels used to select positions
reference: Prefer b=4, falling back to b=2 then b=1 when needed for minimum feasibility; maximize feasible m on the person grid, then maximize n up to 120
primary_constraints: Expected negative coverage, positive per-user shortfall, and normalized set-size differences relative to reference; each source paired mean + kappa times across-user SE <= epsilon
mixture: Choose probabilities minimizing expected effort. Each support action individually meets the budget. Draw the action before acquiring calibration labels. Integrate mixture outcomes exactly during evaluation, after calculating per-user shortfall for each component and calibration draw.
guarantee_scope: LP/source optimization properties and support <=4; no new arbitrary-shift target coverage guarantee. Expected risk is not conditional-on-selected-plan reliability.
comparators: fixed 25/50/75 percent budgets with declared b fallback
random-window CFCR planning executed at reference b
ablation: remove coverage/shortfall/size constraints one at a time
cost_matching: For each main mixture, compare maximum-diversity allocation at its floored expected expense for preferred block counts 1/2/4/8 with feasible lower-b fallback; allow off-grid n and report actual utilization
eligibility: At least 120 retained windows per user, fixed before outcome inspection. PAMAP2 excludes user109; REALDISP excludes users6 and7.
MR: Existing 2016-kernel MiniRocket with standardized logistic probability head, unchanged
IT: Single InceptionTime-style classifier, six modules, 32 filters per branch, kernel sizes 39/19/9, residual every three modules, 40 epochs, batch128, Adam lr0.001, no test-selected checkpoint or hyperparameters
evaluation: Preserve all 48 cost combinations per classifier/score, per-user differences, source constraint checks, support/cost variation, activity-level behavior, actual expenditure and absolute coverage/set utility. Average repetitions within subjects. Report conditional paired bootstrap intervals, not p values inflated by calibration draws.
decision_rule: Do not tune after reading confirmation outcomes. Report failures or lack of advantage and reconsider the claim/venue if the evidence is insufficient. No acceptance guarantee.
